tools.name: search_birth_place
tools.description: Resolve a place name to coordinates for use as the birth place of a Vedic chart. Call this first when the user gives a place name rather than latitude and longitude.

tools.name: get_birth_chart
tools.description: Calculate a sidereal (Lahiri) Vedic birth chart: the ascendant, the nine grahas with sign, degree, nakshatra and house, and the navamsa, dashamsa and hora ascendants. Requires birth date and coordinates. Birth time improves accuracy and defaults to 12:00 when unknown.

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: Get the Vedic panchang for a date and place: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara and Rahu Kaal.

tools.name: check_marriage_compatibility
tools.description: Calculate the 36-guna Ashtakoota marriage compatibility score between two people from their birth details. The calculation is Moon-based, so birth time is optional; supplying it is more accurate because the Moon moves about 13 degrees a day.

tools.name: get_horoscope
tools.description: Get the horoscope for one zodiac sign or for all twelve, for today, the current week, the current month or the year. Returns the reading plus numeric aspect scores, lucky factors and current transits.

tools.name: get_vimshottari_dasha
tools.description: Calculate the Vimshottari mahadasha periods from a birth chart: the nine periods with start and end dates, which one is running now and how many years remain in it. Requires birth date, birth time and coordinates.

tools.name: get_planet_positions
tools.description: Get the sidereal (Lahiri) positions of the nine grahas and the ascendant for any date, time and place: sign, degree, nakshatra, pada and retrograde state. Defaults to now in New Delhi when date, time or place are omitted.

tools.name: get_transit_calendar
tools.description: List upcoming planetary transit events (sign changes, retrograde and direct stations, eclipses) from today for up to 180 days, plus the grahas retrograde right now.

tools.name: find_muhurat
tools.description: Find the most auspicious upcoming dates for an activity using panchang rules (tithi, nakshatra, yoga, weekday, Panchak, Tara Bala). Activities: marriage, griha-pravesh, business, vehicle, travel, education, namkaran, property.

tools.name: get_choghadiya
tools.description: Get the 16 day and night choghadiya periods for a date and place with their quality (auspicious or not), start and end times in local time, the period running now and the next favourable one.

tools.name: check_sade_sati
tools.description: Check whether Shani Sade Sati or Dhaiya (Saturn's transit over the natal Moon) is running for a person, which phase, its dates, and the full list of Sade Sati and Dhaiya windows across about 30 years around now. Based on the Moon sign; birth time is needed only when the Moon changed sign on the birt

tools.name: check_manglik_dosha
tools.description: Check Manglik (Mangal) dosha in a birth chart: whether Mars occupies a dosha house from the ascendant, Moon or Venus, its strength, and any classical cancellation. Requires birth date, birth time and coordinates (the ascendant depends on the time).

tools.name: check_kaal_sarp_dosha
tools.description: Check Kaal Sarp dosha in a birth chart: whether all seven planets lie on one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis, and if so which of the twelve named types it is. Birth time is optional.

tools.name: check_pitra_dosha
tools.description: Check a birth chart for the commonly cited Pitra dosha combinations: the Sun with Rahu or Ketu, Rahu or Ketu in the 9th house, the Sun with Saturn in the 9th house, and the 9th lord with Rahu or Ketu. Lists each combination found. Birth time is needed for the house-based checks.

tools.name: check_gand_mool
tools.description: Check whether a person was born with the Moon in a Gand Mool nakshatra (Ashwini, Ashlesha, Magha, Jyeshtha, Mula or Revati), with the pada and whether it falls on the sign junction (gandanta). Birth time is optional; without it the result says if the Moon changed nakshatra that day.

tools.name: get_numerology
tools.description: Calculate numerology core numbers from a full name and birth date: life path, birth, destiny (expression), soul urge, personality and personal year numbers, with meanings, lucky numbers, colours and days, and the ruling planet.

tools.name: get_festival_calendar
tools.description: List Hindu festival, vrat, Ekadashi, Sankranti and Shraddha dates in a date range (covers the 2026 calendar; dates as observed in India).

tools.name: list_my_charts
tools.description: List the birth charts saved in the signed-in user's AstroLogics account (name, relationship, birth date, time and place). Requires the user to have connected their AstroLogics account.

tools.name: get_my_chart
tools.description: Get a saved birth chart from the signed-in user's AstroLogics account by its id or name (for example "Mom"), with the chart features included in the plan the user already has: planets, houses, the Vimshottari dasha running today (currentDasha) and, where included, antardasha, dasha periods, yogas an

tools.name: save_chart
tools.description: Save a new birth chart to the signed-in user's AstroLogics account so it appears in their saved charts on the website and app. Only call this when the user asks to save a chart. Saving the same birth details again returns the existing chart.

tools.name: get_yogas
tools.description: List the classical yogas present in a birth chart (for example Gaja Kesari, Raja and Dhana yogas) with the planets that form each, its strength and its traditional meaning. Uses a saved chart from the signed-in user's AstroLogics account or given birth details, with the chart features of the user's

tools.name: get_antardasha
tools.description: Get the running Vimshottari mahadasha, antardasha (bhukti) and pratyantardasha with their dates, the next ones, and the antardasha sequence. Uses a saved chart from the signed-in user's AstroLogics account or given birth details, with the chart features of the user's plan.

tools.name: get_divisional_chart
tools.description: Get a divisional (varga) chart: D2 Hora, D9 Navamsa (marriage and dharma), D10 Dashamsa (career) or D12 Dwadashamsa (parents), with each graha's sign and house and the chart's interpretation where available.
